summary: The exact candidate is a substantive source correction and independently fixes the reviewed zero-tail counterexample on gfx950. Its focused suite and independent multi-key zero-tail and nonzero-tail numerical probes pass. No exercised source counterexample remains, but the original CUDA SM90/H20 GLM-5.3-Flash contract could not be run on the assigned ROCm GPU, so full resolution is unverified rather than accepted as proven.

tests.what_was_measured: The probe caught and recorded the expected base ValueError rejecting CUDA fp8_e4m3 with TileLang/TileLang, reproducing the original source-level configuration blocker. Imports resolved to the prepared checkout.
5 tests passed; the base suite encoded rejection of CUDA TileLang FP8 and therefore did not demonstrate the requested functionality.
11 passed and 2 CUDA-only tests skipped. The cross-vendor GLM-5.3-Flash zero-tail regression compiled and executed on gfx950.

Independent GPU probes: zero-tail multi-key/repeated/scrambled-index output had 0.027627935633063316 relative error against an FP32 attention reference; nonzero-tail d_tail=64 one-hot output had 0.0 relative error.
1 selected test and 6 subtests passed, with 93 tests deselected, exercising backend-resolution integration boundaries.
Candidate diff has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution_evidence: Candidate TileLang kernels compiled and executed on one assigned AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 under ROCm 7.2. Both independent numerical boundary probes synchronized successfully. No CUDA kernel executed.
remaining_counterexamples: Exact candidate commit 4715caf was not executed on CUDA SM90/H20, so CUDA compilation, graph capture, and serving behavior remain unverified locally.
GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable, so the full model path with index_kpool=4, speculative decoding, capacity gain, and semantic accuracy remains unverified locally.
Upstream sm_121 feedback reports a repeatable HumanEval decrease for raw-layout FP8 KV (85.4% versus 90.2% BF16); this review did not reproduce or resolve that quality tradeoff.
remaining_limitations: Assigned architecture was AMD gfx950/ROCm 7.2, not NVIDIA H20/SM90 CUDA.
No full-model, multi-GPU, multi-node, capacity, or broad accuracy run was possible without the model weights and requested hardware.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes Python and TileLang DSL only; TileLang runtime compilation used /opt/tilelang/build.
